messages:
eli: Heads-up — prepping SDK publish for py@1.9.2 and ts@2.5.0 inside the 18:00-20:00 PT change window. Starting preflight in 20m, please monitor.
sana: copied checklist into the branch. Key items: wheel/checksum, twine GPG signing, npm dist-tag, smoke tests, docs pin if we abort.
jordan: note — KMS key rotation scheduled tonight at 18:30 PT. Confirm CI still has access to signing key before we publish.
release-manager: if we detect any sig mismatch or 401 auth regression in smoke, we soft-pin to the last stable and abort. No risky retries during peak window.
devexbot: deploy-bot: queued publish job 98321 for redwood-sdk-py@1.9.2 and job 98322 for redwood-sdk-ts@2.5.0
eli: deploy-bot triggered py job: 98321 started. Running wheel checksum and signature verification now.
sana: running smoke group A (auth + streaming) against staging.
devexbot: smoke-tests: py-group-A started (run id s-202403).
jordan: saw a failing log: `twine: GPG verification failed: BAD_SIGNATURE` on the wheel for py. Could be CI key rotation.
eli: pausing ts publish; I'm going to cancel job 98322 until we confirm signing. Cancelling now.
devexbot: deploy-bot: cancelled job 98322 (user: eli)
audrey: recommend do NOT push `latest` tag for ts until we republish. Instead soft-pin docs CDN to 2.4.9 and add a note in changelog.
sana: quick mitigation: create a registry redirect and change docs install snippet to `pip install redwood-sdk==1.9.1` / `npm install redwood-sdk@2.4.9` until republish. I'll open a PR.
jordan: commands if we need to flip tags quickly: 
```
# remove bad latest
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk latest
# point latest back to safe version
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.4.9 latest
# for pip, we can't unpublish wheels, but update docs and pypi release notes
```
eli: did untag sequence for ts locally, pushing the tag flip.
devexbot: npm dist-tag flip executed by eli (job 98324)
release-manager: roll-back criteria (approved): any of:
- core auth smoke failing > 1 minute continuously
- token handshake 401 rate > 3% across synthetic tests
- necessary signing key not recoverable within 30 minutes
If triggered: revert tag, mark release blocked, notify customers and schedule immediate republish window.
audrey: drafting release note: short explanation + timeline + recommended pinned install commands + apology. Will keep it lightweight.
sana: PR ready with docs change and a premium snippet showing `pip install redwood-sdk==1.9.1` and `npm i @redwood/sdk@2.4.9`. Also added a deprecation blurb for the old sync client per request.
jordan: when we republish we'll run: `gpg --list-secret-keys && twine upload -s dist/*` — ensure CI has GPG agent and key available. If rotation broke it, we'll fallback to ephemeral signing key only after security signoff.
eli: target: attempt republish at 19:10 PT after KMS rotation completes and CI key re-sync. If green, we push `latest` and close the docs pin PR. If not, keep pins and notify via status page.
release-manager: agreed. Notify #support and PMs if we end up extending the pin to customers. Keep this thread for live updates.
eli: updating — republish in 5m. Will post results here. :thumbsup:
